Ponno.title: Ponno
Ponno.description: An AI driven e-commerce business growing platform.
Ponno.longDescription: Ponno is an AI-driven e-commerce business growth platform that helps businesses grow their sales and revenue using AI-powered tools and strategies.
challenges: Context awareness for different operating systems
Robust error handling for network requests
impact: 10-15 minutes daily time savings for users

coterm.title: Coterm
coterm.description: Copilot for terminal built using Rust, Vercel edge function and OpenAI API with natural language command generation
coterm.longDescription: Coterm is a revolutionary terminal copilot that bridges the gap between natural language and command-line interfaces. Built with Rust for performance and integrated with OpenAI's API, it allows developers to describe what they want to do in plain English and receive the exact command they need.
features: Natural language to CLI command generation
Safety measures and dangerous command detection
challenges: Context awareness for different operating systems
Robust error handling for network requests
impact: 10-15 minutes daily time savings for users

ramble.title: Ramble
ramble.description: Application to transcribe meetings, get overheard, commitment, and follow up from meetings using AI
ramble.longDescription: Ramble is an AI-powered meeting management platform that transforms how teams handle meeting transcription, action items, and follow-ups. It automatically captures, transcribes, and analyzes meetings to extract key insights and commitments.
features: Voice note taking with AI assistance

resume.title: Re:sume
resume.description: Web application to create and enhance resumes using AI with PDF generation and OpenAI GPT3 integration
resume.longDescription: Re:sume is an AI-powered resume builder that helps professionals create compelling resumes. It uses advanced AI to enhance content, suggest improvements, and generate polished PDF outputs tailored for specific job applications.
challenges: AI prompt engineering for resume content
impact: Reduced time spent on resume formatting

bochon.title: Bochon
bochon.description: Performance dashboard for various Bengali Speech to Text models developed for Bengali.ai
bochon.longDescription: Bochon is a comprehensive performance dashboard developed for Bengali.ai to showcase and compare various Bengali Speech-to-Text models. It provides detailed analytics, benchmarks, and interactive demonstrations of different ASR models.

sust-ghms.title: SUST GHMS
sust-ghms.description: Guest house management system with room booking, authentication, and profile management
sust-ghms.longDescription: SUST Guest House Management System is a comprehensive web application designed to streamline the booking and management of guest house facilities at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology.

instatweet.title: Instatweet
instatweet.description: Twitter clone with Instagram-like interface featuring authentication, posts, comments, and follows
instatweet.longDescription: Instatweet is a unique social media platform that combines the visual appeal of Instagram with the microblogging functionality of Twitter. Built as a full-stack web application with modern technologies.
impact: Learning project for social media features
